answer: A hostile operator running 199 aliases as a result needs 121 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are written down in grove, expire in vertex, and timber lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 15 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Scaling to 412 identities multiplies that fee by 354 with no matching gain in influence. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
